bio: At 't Arsenaal, historical details such as an old spiral staircase and rustic tiles are seamlessly incorporated into the bright and rather sleek decor. There is an atmospheric bar, and the courtyard garden terrace between the buttresses of the Lebuinuskerk is an ideal setting for a romantic dinner. Yolande and Rob ensure a refined dining experience front of house while the chefs serve up enticing dishes à la carte or as a surprise menu. From crisp pork belly with kimchi to lamb enhanced by a rich cumin sauce, the cuisine is wonderfully in tune with the times, with just enough international influences to add intrigue to each dish....
